reference_freshness: Same enclosing run, candidate, interpreter, snapshotted specs and successful preceding owned unreduced jobs. Exact expected directory/command/admission/execution/log hashes and chronology. No reference states drive transitions.
comparison: Every independently generated certificate has the same original case identity and compressed bytes as its actual fresh unreduced reference; every typed prefix is independently audited; complete original-order case summaries match. Run-specific provenance is separate from deterministic results. Aggregate counts, attestation census where present, and earliest-prefix witnesses with original tie-breaking are independently recomputed from all generated and retained cases.
acceptance_gate: Fresh same-run references and all declared checks under owned jobs. One exact committed candidate must pass two complete 83-command gates preserving all 50 historical commands and packets 01–03, the 48-history selected packet, and five shared-validation commands; two owned final receipt/source audits; two independent same-model final reviews binding actual proposed body and brief; fresh verified draft publication. Execution requires two new exact-candidate and policy approvals; old source reviews are advisory only.
non_oracle_assurance: Independent initializers and original checked transition block, checked visited-prefix ledger and reviewed source provenance. Wrong-reference-leaf-mapping control does not prove absence of an oracle-copy implementation.
